claims.text: The Assembly press release issued by the Chief Clerk on 25 November 2024 states that the Office of the Lord Speaker received on Saturday 23 November 2024 a Notice of Intention to Move a Motion for a Vote of No Confidence in the Prime Minister, Hon. Siaosi Sovaleni, submitted by Hon. Dr 'Aisake Eke (Tongatapu 5) together with the motion, signed in support by 10 Members including Eke, and that the Office was acting as required by clause 50B of the Constitution.
claims.locator: Press release body, paragraphs 1-2; issue line
claims.uncertainty: Context only. The motion was never put to a vote: it was removed from the agenda after the resignation (to_speaker_vonc_withdrawn_procedure_20241209). The ten signatories are not named and are not a party or coalition observation.
